decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (A.01.1 Rev 05 and A.01.2 Rev 05 received: 08/03/2018.
Drawings approved under 01030/10/P1 dated: 13/12/2013: PR-02, PR-02, received 27/11/2013) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 2 - The new and altered windows formed in the eastern elevation shall be obscure glazed and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.
description: Variation of condition 2 (approved plans) to allow for larger ground floor extension following planning permission 01030/10/P1 dated 13/12/2013 for Erection of a single storey rear extension following demolition of existing extension. Extend width of existing rear roof extension and installation of three roof windows to front elevation.
